no_security_headers.label: Fewer than 3 of 5 baseline security headers configured in the repo

no_csp.label: No Content-Security-Policy configured in the repo

rls_disabled.label: Supabase: at least one table created in SQL with no `enable row level security`

open_write_policy.label: RLS policy that lets anyone / any signed-in user update or delete every row (`using (true)`)

rls_off_or_open_write.label: Supabase: table without RLS or an open write policy

unauth_route_high.label: Next.js: route or server action that writes to the DB or calls a privileged/paid API with no visible auth check

unauth_route_any.label: Next.js: any route/action finding (high or medium)

hardcoded_secret.label: Credential hard-coded in source (critical or high)

public_env_secret.label: Secret-named variable behind NEXT_PUBLIC_/VITE_ (shipped to the browser)

any_secret_exposure.label: Any of: committed .env with secrets, hard-coded credential, public-prefixed secret

build_safety_off.label: Type safety switched off (strict off or build errors ignored)

next_middleware_cve.label: Next.js version affected by CVE-2025-29927 with middleware in use

unverified_webhook.label: Webhook handler with no signature / shared-secret check

service_role_in_client.label: Module that reads the Supabase service_role key is reachable from browser code

server_sdk_in_client.label: Server-only SDK (LLM, DB driver, Stripe, mail) imported into browser code

unsanitized_html.label: dangerouslySetInnerHTML with a dynamic, unsanitized value

firebase_open_write.label: Firebase rules that allow unconditional write

validation.note: Verdicts were recorded for the last three rounds; precision is computed over the sampled findings that the final version (a48a72a) still reports.

header_cross_check.note: Repo-wide text search (source, config, nginx/toml/yaml) for any of the header names, done outside launch-check.
